mods.name: ai-crew
mods.title: AI Crew
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Helper characters that build your ghosts and clear deconstruction marks on their own like construction bots (hand-crafting what is missing), and mine, craft and fetch on order, from a panel (top left). With the fse loader they also chat through a free LLM and speak out loud, and ADA announces your milestones. Single player.

mods.name: carry
mods.title: Carry
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Pick up a section of your base and put it down somewhere else, as it is: buildings with what's in them, belts with their items, recipes, fluids and wires. Drag over it with the Carry tool, then click where it goes (R turns it). Instant, no robots.

mods.name: ez-actions
mods.title: EZ Actions
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: A radial menu for anything you do often (port of the Minecraft mod EZ Actions by z2six). Hold U, flick the mouse toward a slice, let go. Slices fire any of the game's controls or another mod's keybind, a shortcut-bar shortcut, a direct hotkey, chat commands, or equip a saved loadout. Nested bundles with their own keys, an in-game editor, import/export, and a remote API. Controls, hotkeys and commands need the FSE loader.

mods.name: pole-tidy
mods.title: Pole Tidy
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Removes electric poles that other poles make redundant (as poles gain quality and cover more): a selection tool, and an optional auto mode when poles are upgraded. Never unpowers a building or splits a grid. Safe to add or remove at any time.

mods.name: robo-grid
mods.title: Robo Grid
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Grows your robot network on a square grid to wherever you build (or over an area you select): roboport ghosts edge-first, a pole chain to power each, construction bots requested for it. Tidies roboports made redundant as roboports gain quality. Safe to add or remove at any time.

mods.name: smart-research-queue
mods.title: Smart Research Queue
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Ultimate Research Queue's GUI with Auto Research built in: queue technologies (prerequisites included) and, when the queue runs dry, pick the next research from your goals or by strategy, limited to the science packs you allow or actually produce. Fork of Ultimate Research Queue for 2.x and Auto Research (both MIT).

mods.name: underground-gap-fill
mods.title: Underground Gap Fill
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: Fills the one-tile gap after an underground pipe or belt: between two undergrounds (straight or round a corner) and, for pipes, between an underground and a machine's pipe connection. Waits until you stop drag-building, so drags keep their full underground range. Uses the item from your inventory, or a ghost when you have none. Safe to add or remove at any time.

mods.name: wx-trash-slot
mods.title: Trash Slot
mods.author: mtopfox
mods.description: A trash slot attached to your inventory (port of the Minecraft mod TrashSlot). Hover a stack and press Delete to throw it in; the next delete destroys what was there (one undo brings the last destroyed stack back). Shift+Delete throws in every stack of that item. Click the slot to take it back, Delete on it destroys it. The slot sits beside the window or floats anywhere; with FSE, drag it. Safe to add or remove at any time.
